name: blur-out-up
title: Blur Out Up
description: Words arrive clean and depart upward with increasing blur for airy exits.

variables.label: Direction
variables.description: Where the offset the timeline drives points.

variables.label: Distance
variables.description: Scales the travel offset, so the words cover a shorter or longer run in the same time.

variables.label: Blur
variables.description: Scales the blur radius the timeline drives, from a light haze to a full smear.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Word colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.
